properties.notes: The minimum number of net dwellings is 20 as it is based on both a prior approval and a permission. The prior approval relates to the change of use of the building to 14 apartments (P16/S4085/PDO) and the permission relates to the conversion of the roof into six flats (P16/S4117/FUL).
